d:
The Rockets defeated the Wizards, 147-119 tonight in Washington. Amen Thompson finished with a team-high 26 points along with 7 rebounds and 7 assists for the Rockets, while Kevin Durant tallied 25 points, 5 assists and 4 rebounds in the game. Alex Sarr recorded 25 points, 9 rebounds and 3 three pointers. The Rockets improve their record to 11-3 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 4-10 for the season.
